g.text: Decision tree: Claude Code, Copilot Agent and homelab

text.tspan: Does the task need to send an email,
sensitive, or tied to my homelab?
multiple repos or my local network?
GitHub task on a public repo?
- triggers: push, PR, issue, cron, dispatch
Copilot Pro 10 USD/month → 300 premium requests, +0.04 USD/req beyond that
Claude Code Pro ≈20 USD/month → limits shared with Claude.ai
Claude Code Max ≈100 USD/month → 5x or 20x higher quota
Public Actions: free — Private Actions: ≈0.006 USD/min (Linux)
I prefer to control it locally
